title: Inspora
tagline: A curated archive of visual design and creative work.
summary: Inspora collects visual references across web, branding, product, motion, illustration, 3D, and print. Browse recent or featured work for ideas, then follow an entry's original link to explore the creator's source.
highlights: Browse seven creative disciplines in one visual archive
Switch between latest and featured work
Individual entries can credit creators and link to original work; a weekly email is available

title: Strix
tagline: Open-source autonomous AI penetration testing agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities with real exploit validation.
summary: Strix is an open-source AI penetration testing tool that deploys autonomous AI hacker agents to dynamically execute code, discover vulnerabilities, and validate findings through real proof-of-concept exploits. Built for developers and security teams, Strix features multi-agent orchestration, full pentest toolkits (recon, exploit, validation), auto-patch generation, compliance-ready reporting, and seamless CI/CD pipeline integration.
highlights: Autonomous AI pentesting agents executing dynamic security analysis and multi-agent team orchestration
Real exploit validation generating working PoCs to eliminate false positives found in static analysis tools
Full application security pipeline with recon, exploit, auto-patch generation, compliance reports, and CI/CD scan hooks

title: getdesign.md
tagline: DESIGN.md collection and design system analysis catalog for AI coding agents.
summary: A browsable collection of 300+ independent design system analyses following Google's official DESIGN.md specification. Drop one into your repository to provide AI coding agents with colors, typography, spacing, and visual language guidance.
highlights: 300+ catalog of real-world website DESIGN.md analyses
Conforms to Google's official DESIGN.md specification for AI coders
Prevents generic AI layouts by providing structured visual language constraints

title: Design Engineer Tools
tagline: A curated list of useful tools for web-focused design engineers.
summary: Comprehensive directory curated by James Warner aggregating best-in-class tools across 15+ specialized domains, including web design inspiration, AI code generators, UI component libraries, and CSS/color utilities.
highlights: Curated specifically for design engineers bridging UI design and web development
Covers 15+ domains including Inspiration, AI Code, UI Components, and Web Utilities
Fast, clean, dark-mode reference directory with direct links to tools like shadcn/ui and Cursor

title: Checklist Design
tagline: Design checklists for websites, web apps, mobile, components, and flows.
summary: A curated collection of UI/UX design checklists covering web, mobile, components, user flows, accessibility, and launch readiness. Check every detail and ship better work.

title: vLLM Engine
tagline: Easy, fast, and cheap LLM serving for everyone
summary: High-throughput and memory-efficient LLM serving engine featuring PagedAttention for continuous batching and near-zero memory waste.

title: Linear
tagline: The purposeful tool for modern software development.
summary: Fast, keyboard-driven issue tracking with real-time sync, sleek dark mode aesthetics, and deep git integrations.

title: AI Elements
tagline: Pre-built, accessible React components for AI chat interfaces.
summary: Comprehensive collection of modular React primitives designed specifically for LLM responses, tool calls, streaming text, and prompt inputs.

title: Stitch Design System
tagline: AI-driven high-fidelity screen design and component generation framework.
summary: A powerful platform that bridges prompt-driven UI generation and production-ready clean design systems with automated AST code output.
